Exact crop from the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side; cover "official text as of April 27, 2013"), PDF page 3: the slip of •5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V). It prints the text of version PC-E3, [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]] (the current text). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]] (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
